summary: Backend API testing for Iteration 22 - New Features. All 21 tests passed (100%). Verified Pixie AI with weather-aware activity suggestions, Check-ins endpoint for location history, Location alerts, Pantry CRUD, Events (no stack overflow), Family members, and Shopping list.
critical_code_review_comments: Pixie AI endpoint (/api/ai/pixie) correctly detects activity keywords and includes weather context in responses
Weather API integration working - Pixie suggests indoor activities when cold/snowy, outdoor when nice weather
Check-ins CRUD endpoints (POST /api/checkins, GET /api/checkins/{user_id}, GET /api/checkins/{user_id}/last) all working
Location alerts endpoint (GET /api/location/alerts) returns alerts correctly
Geofence alert creation (POST /api/location/geofence-alert) working with proper notification creation
Pantry CRUD endpoints still working - note: POST returns {item: {...}} wrapper
Events endpoint responds quickly without stack overflow (verified < 10s response time)
Family members endpoint working for parent role
Shopping list add item working with auto-approval for parent role

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 verified new features: 1) Pixie AI now includes weather data for activity suggestions - detects keywords like 'activity', 'weather', 'fun', 'play', 'outside' and fetches weather from OpenWeather API (or uses simulated data if no API key). 2) Check-ins endpoint for location history working - POST creates check-in, GET retrieves history, GET /last retrieves most recent. 3) Location alerts endpoint returns geofence enter/exit alerts. 4) All previous features (Pantry, Events, Shopping) still working.

pixie_ai_weather.notes: Weather keywords trigger weather context inclusion. Tested: basic message, activity suggestion, weather keyword, fun keyword. Pixie correctly suggests indoor activities for cold/snowy weather.
